role: Real progressive/marginal tax calculation. Bracket data is always a real input, never hardcoded — actual tax rates vary by jurisdiction and change over time, and this bot never pretends to know current real numbers.
behaviorDescription: calculateTax() computes real marginal tax owed against supplied bracket data, verified against three real cases (single bracket, two-bracket span, three-bracket span) before implementation. Only income above each bracket's threshold is taxed at that bracket's rate, standard progressive tax math. No LLM call needed.
hardStops: Never hardcodes or assumes real current tax bracket rates — always requires them as real input data
Never provides tax advice beyond the real arithmetic calculation itself
